messages:
kai: Quick postmortem follow-up: same GPU pools spiking during batch windows. Need owners, clear timelines, and a recurring detection for the pattern. Short thread pls.

sara: I can take the quota escalation path. I'll assemble 14/30/90d usage slices and file the infra->finance request. target: submit by Thu COB. owner: sara.

deepa: I'll lead autoscaler policy checks. suspect our scaleDownDelay and coolDown are too short causing flapping during burst. Plan: audit current policies and run sim tests. ETA Tue.

matt: For scheduler side I'll prototype a conservative scoring change: prefer bin-packing less aggressively during heavy enqueue windows. small canary on pool-gpu-burst. owner: matt. start Mon.
kai: Recurring detector idea: if same pool hits >=85% usable for 4 of 7 days OR pending >120 for 3h, open remediation ticket. who wants to own alert + automation?

ops-bot: Tip: use the weekly_capacity_digest job for baseline stats.

sara: I'll add the alert and wire a webhook to create a tracker issue with pre-filled template. ETA Fri.

deepa: Autoscaler experiments (brief):
- baseline capture (48h)
- increase stable window to 6m, scaleDownDelay +10m
- tune targetUtilization from 0.7 -> 0.65, observe node churn
rollback: revert if we see >2x pending jobs or >20% higher infra cost for 24h
owner: deepa.

matt: Canary plan: 1) change scoring weight from 30->18 on binpack plugin for pool-gpu-burst (2 nodes canary), 24h observe, expand if no regression. rollback on pending >100 for >20m.

kai: Headroom policy proposal: set soft headroom 12% during 08:00-20:00 local, and trigger autoscale buffer when predicted load (ML model) + buffer < 15%. will document in tracking doc.

sara: quota ask: +8 hard GPUs to pool-gpu-prod, request includes p95 wait, queued job trends, and cost delta. attaching numbers in ticket.

ops-bot: Scheduled: capacity_audit will run Sat 02:30 UTC and post results to #eng-sre.

kai: Summary actions:
- sara: finance quota request + attachments (due Thu COB)
- deepa: autoscaler audit + sim tests (due Tue)
- matt: scheduler canary on pool-gpu-burst (start Mon)
- sara: alert + automation for regression detector (due Fri)
- kai: document headroom policy + trigger logic (due Wed)

Please react to claim or adjust. goal: have the tracker updated and first canaries running before next oncall rotation. :clipboard:
